meta.name: eli5
meta.description: WHAT: Explains a codebase, a folder, a feature, a command or a pull request to someone who knows nothing about it, as a PR Lens canvas whose walkthrough builds the picture one part at a time. WHEN: /eli5 <thing>, or asked to explain code simply, for a beginner, a new hire, a non-engineer, or 'like I'm five'. KEYWORDS: eli5, explain like I'm five, explain simply, beginner, onboarding, walkthrough, diagram, PR Lens

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把看不懂的代码或改动,一步步讲成图解让人听懂
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接手陌生代码库,或要给新人、非技术同事讲清代码
copy.tagline_en: Walk someone through unfamiliar code or a change, one part at a time, as a picture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just inherited unfamiliar code or must explain code to newcomers

howto.what: 把代码库、文件夹、功能、命令或 PR 讲给完全不懂的人:先给出一句话答案,再用一页可播放的 PR Lens 画布一块块添图,最后才呈现全图;回复只有这句话和画布链接。
howto.when: 当你输入 /eli5 <对象>,或要求把代码讲得简单、讲给新手或非工程人员听,或说「像讲给五岁小孩」时触发。它需要同一仓库里的 PR Lens 技能已装在一旁,否则会先请你安装。

say.note: 生成并推送一页画布,回复一句话和链接

say.text: eli5 这个 PR,讲给新来的同事听
say.note: 把这条 PR 拆成一块块画出来

say.text: eli5 我们整个项目,像讲给五岁小孩那样
say.note: 从第一屏一路长到全图

howto.what_en: Turns a codebase, folder, feature, command or PR into a playable PR Lens canvas for a beginner: a one-sentence answer first, then one part added at a time until the whole picture is shown. Claude replies with the sentence and the link.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /eli5 <thing>, or when asked to explain code simply for a beginner, a new hire or a non-engineer, or 'like I'm five'. Needs the PR Lens skill installed beside it.

say_en.note: Builds and pushes a canvas, then replies with one line and the link.

say_en.text: eli5 this PR for a new hire
say_en.note: Explains the pull request one part at a time.

say_en.text: eli5 our whole app like I'm five
say_en.note: Grows the canvas from one screen to the whole picture.
